name: Seva Memory
description: Accessibility + Field Memory for NGOs. Processes field notes, answers queries via Slack RTS + Qdrant, generates alt-text, and self-learns from verified knowledge.
author: SETU

manifest.name: message_listener
manifest.description: Listens for incoming Slack messages and dispatches to field note / query / image handlers

manifest.name: search_tribal_knowledge
manifest.description: Search SETU's Qdrant memory store for verified NGO field knowledge

manifest.name: snapshot_knowledge
manifest.description: Store verified knowledge into SETU's permanent Qdrant memory

manifest.name: transcribe_audio
manifest.description: Transcribe a Hindi/English field worker voice note using OpenAI Whisper

manifest.name: generate_alt_text
manifest.description: Generate accessible alt-text for an image using GPT-4o Vision
